name: an if/while test is no longer a decision line
expect: decision lines are the if-test, the return and the exit call — not the plain assignment

name: a return is no longer a decision line
expect: decision lines are the if-test, the return and the exit call — not the plain assignment

name: a self_test body counts as behaviour
edits: elif isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and "self_test" in node.name:
expect: a self_test function's body is not behaviour

name: a literal module pin counts as behaviour
expect: docstring, import, literal pin, blank and comment lines are not behaviour

name: an anchor covers only its FIRST line
expect: an anchor covers every line its text spans

name: an empty anchor covers everything
expect: an empty anchor covers nothing (not every line)

name: an anchored line is warned anyway
edits: if n in skip or n in covered or n not in decide or n > len(lines):
if n in skip or n not in decide or n > len(lines):

name: a deletion hunk counts one added line
edits: start, count = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2) or "1") or 1
expect: a pure deletion hunk (+N,0) adds no line

name: ⭐ an unknown base reports a clean zero instead of CANNOT RUN
expect: ⭐ an unknown base is CANNOT RUN (exit 2), never 'nothing changed'

name: refused manifests report a clean pass
edits: return 2, ["CANNOT RUN — the mutation manifests do not load:"]
return 0, ["CANNOT RUN — the mutation manifests do not load:"]
expect: manifests the loader refuses (here: none at all) are CANNOT RUN, never a clean pass
